<thought>To locate the template that performs the Doebner modification, I will search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates applicable to a generic cinnamic‑acid product (SMILES O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1) that form a C=C bond and break a C=O bond. This should retrieve the appropriate template, after which I can obtain its mapped reaction SMILES and template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C(O)C=CC1=CC=CC=C1",
    "bonds_formed": ["C=C"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=O"]
}</action_input>
